name: Antigravity
description: Run Cindy tasks with the Google Antigravity CLI (agy) installed on this computer.
releaseNotes: Tasks on another computer and shared tasks now use about a third of the Gemini quota on agy 1.5.19 or later (macOS and Linux): they run under Antigravity's default agent, which is billed at the normal rate, instead of a custom agent billed at four times the rate. Hooks keep Antigravity's own file, command, browser and image tools off in the session and its subagents; a task whose hooks did not load, or in which Antigravity runs such a tool anyway, is stopped.

harnesses.name: Antigravity
harnesses.description: Runs tasks with the agy command-line agent installed on this computer, signed in with your Google account.
